// Central configuration - mirrors the CONFIGURATION region of M365-WeeklyReport.ps1.
// No credentials or secrets live here - authentication is handled entirely via the
// n8n credential attached to the HTTP Request nodes.

return [{
  json: {
    graphBaseUrl: 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0',

    organisationName: 'Your Organisation',
    reportOwner: 'IT Infrastructure Team',

    senderMailbox: 'reports@example.com',
    recipientEmails: ['recipient@example.com'],
    ccEmails: [],

    sharePointSiteId: 'REPLACE_WITH_SHAREPOINT_SITE_ID',
    sharePointFolderPath: '/Reports/M365WeeklyReport',
    skipEmailSend: true,

    domainDisplayNames: {
      'bkk.example': 'BKK',
      'threedot.example': 'threedot.example',
      'example.com': 'example.com',
      'example.org': 'example.org'
    },
    alwaysIncludeDomains: ['bkk.example', 'threedot.example', 'example.com'],
    minUsersForOwnTab: 3,
    excludeOnMicrosoftDomain: true,

    highUsagePct: 90,
    mediumUsagePct: 70,

    // 0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday. Anchor day used by 'Reporting Period Logic'.
    weekEndingDayOfWeek: 0,

    excludedSkus: [
      'POWER_BI_PRO',
      'WINDOWS_STORE',
      'FLOW_FREE',
      'POWER_BI_STANDARD',
      'Teams_Premium_(for_Departments)',
      'RIGHTSMANAGEMENT_ADHOC',
      'POWERAPPS_DEV'
    ],

    skuFriendlyNames: {
      'O365_BUSINESS_ESSENTIALS': 'Microsoft 365 Business Basic',
      'O365_BUSINESS_PREMIUM': 'Microsoft 365 Business Standard',
      'SPB': 'Microsoft 365 Business Premium',
      'SPE_E3': 'Microsoft 365 E3',
      'SPE_E5': 'Microsoft 365 E5',
      'ENTERPRISEPACK': 'Office 365 E3',
      'ENTERPRISEPREMIUM': 'Office 365 E5',
      'EXCHANGESTANDARD': 'Exchange Online (Plan 1)',
      'EXCHANGEENTERPRISE': 'Exchange Online (Plan 2)',
      'AAD_PREMIUM': 'Microsoft Entra ID P1',
      'AAD_PREMIUM_P2': 'Microsoft Entra ID P2',
      'MCOMEETADV': 'Microsoft Teams Audio Conferencing',
      'TEAMS_EXPLORATORY': 'Microsoft Teams Exploratory',
      'PROJECTPROFESSIONAL': 'Project Plan 3',
      'VISIOCLIENT': 'Visio Plan 2',
      'MICROSOFT_BUSINESS_CENTER': 'Microsoft Business Center',
      'POWER_BI_STANDARD': 'Power BI (Free)'
    }
  }
}];
